editorial.blurb: This hidden gem on Devon Street delivers an authentic Hyderabadi biryani experience that rivals the real thing, with carefully spiced curries and kebabs that transport you straight to India.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the goat dum biryani and ask about daily specials like haleem—the biryani often sells out, so arrive early or call ahead, and don't skip the zafrani malai mutton if you want something beyond the rice dishes.
